description: This file contains instrumentation functions for various web frameworks, HTTP libraries, databases, and other services using OpenTelemetry. It defines functions to instrument FastAPI, Requests, HTTPX, Flask, SQLAlchemy, SQLite3, Redis, and OpenAI, primarily for tracing and monitoring purposes.

classes.name: InstrumentedClient
classes.description: Custom subclass of httpx.Client that wraps the send method with tracing.

classes.name: InstrumentedAsyncClient
classes.description: Custom subclass of httpx.AsyncClient that wraps the async send method with tracing.

methods.name: _decode_body
methods.description: Decodes a request or response body to UTF-8 if it is in bytes.

methods.name: _instrument_fastapi
methods.description: Instruments FastAPI applications for tracing, adding hooks for request and response bodies.

methods.name: _instrument_requests
methods.description: Instruments the requests library for tracing HTTP requests and responses.

methods.name: _instrument_httpx
methods.description: Instruments the httpx library for tracing HTTP requests, responses, and wraps the Client classes.

methods.name: _instrument_flask
methods.description: Instruments Flask applications for tracing, adding hooks for request and response data.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlalchemy
methods.description: Instruments SQLAlchemy to trace database queries, including capturing result data for SELECT statements.

methods.name: _instrument_dbapi
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting generic DB-API connections (not implemented).

methods.name: _instrument_sqlite3
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting sqlite3 database interactions (not implemented).

methods.name: _instrument_redis
methods.description: Instruments Redis client for tracing commands and responses.

methods.name: _instrument_openai
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting OpenAI API calls (not implemented).
